title: TDRPFormer: Texture-Debiased Reliable Prototype Transformer for Pixel-Level Steel Surface Defect Segmentation
mechanism: Build normal-texture prototypes from high-confidence background and subtract them from defect features, route a few reliable prototypes to mask queries, and add a continuity module for slender defects.
adaptation: Multi-crystalline grain boundaries mimic cracks: average layer2 features over confident sp_multi / sp_mono background per image and subtract a learned projection from decoder features; no query head needed.
evidence: R: best saliency metrics on ESDIs-SOD (MAE 0.0185, weighted F 0.882) and NEU-DET; no IoU on thin defects; no code.
min_experiment: Arm: house + background-prototype subtraction; baseline: house; metric: CV crack relP@2 on multi cells and material IoU; kill if multi-cell relP@2 gain < +0.02.
prior_overlap: none: mask-classification / prototype decoders never tried; D23 holds mask transformers generally.
